```yaml
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install mdbook
        run: cargo install mdbook

      - name: Add mdbook-spec preprocessor
        run: |
          cargo install mdbook-spec --git https://github.com/rue-language/mdbook-spec.git --branch main

      - name: Vendor dependencies
        run: cargo vendor

      - name: Build website
        run: cd website && mdbook build

      - name: Commit changes
        id: commit_changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: 'website/book/**/*.html'
          commit: 'Deploy website and update spec'
          author_name: GitHub Actions
          author_email: actions@github.com

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: website/book
          commit-message: ${{ steps.commit_changes.outputs.commit_message }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a CI/CD pipeline to automatically deploy the Rue website and language specification to GitHub Pages when changes are made to the `website/`, `docs/spec/`, or the workflow itself. It includes steps to check out the code, set up Rust, install mdbook, add the mdbook-spec preprocessor, vendor dependencies, build the website, commit changes, and deploy to GitHub Pages using the `JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action`.

      - name: Checkout code

      - name: Set up Rust

      - name: Install mdbook

          cargo install mdbook-spec --git https://github.com/rue-language/mdbook-spec.git --branch main

      - name: Vendor dependencies

      - name: Build website

      - name: Commit changes
